# `aitbc market download`

Download IPFS content by market job, access token, or free CID.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc market download [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--rental-id` | text | — | no | Market job ID for a paid rental |
| `--access-key` | text | — | no | Rental access key |
| `--access-secret` | text | — | no | Rental access secret |
| `--cid` | text | — | no | Free CID retrieval (bypasses access token) |
| `--output-path` | path | — | no | Write retrieved content to this path |
| `--wait` | flag | `false` | no | Wait for the CID to become available on the network |
| `--output` | choice | — | no | Output format (alias for --format) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc market download
aitbc market download --output json
```
